These files are copied unchanged from the test data of the sibling OneAudio project (same licence, MIT OR Apache-2.0, © Recursive AI, LLC).
They are synthetic: sine and noise signals encoded with ffmpeg, AMR frames of pseudo-random bytes, and an iTunes gapless tag added by script.
They cover AMR in 3GP, the iTunSMPB tag, a fragmented audio file, ALAC with several audio tracks and a two-track file.
The tests in tests/OneMedia.Tests/IsoBmff use them; they are not regenerated by tools/gen-isobmff-testdata.sh.
